name: Michael Boenning
headline: Experienced transformation and reorganization advisor
summary:
Senior transformation leader and project manager with 17 years of experience delivering turnarounds, restructuring, profitability improvement and cost transformation for multinational corporations and PE-owned industrial businesses.

Former Director at Strategy& (Booz & Company) and Senior Consultant at Siemens Management Consulting, advising CEOs and operational leaders on how to stabilize performance and accelerate transformation in complex, engineering-driven environments.

I lead critical programs end-to-end — from strategy design to hands-on implementation, including PMO setup, operational governance, milestone steering, performance management, pricing improvement and commercial execution. My focus is always on tangible financial results.

Core expertise:
• Transformation & Turnaround Management
• PMO Leadership & Operational Excellence
• Profitability & Cost Reduction (SG&A, R&D, quality, supply chain)
• Portfolio Optimization, PMI & Carve-outs
• Pricing, Go-to-Market & Commercial Performance

Industry focus: Manufacturing, building materials, industrial equipment, facility management and technical services.
Projects delivered in 15+ countries across Europe, Asia and the Americas.

Academic background: Business Administration (LMU Munich) and Technology Management (TU Munich).

If your organization needs someone who combines executive-level advisory with pragmatic implementation and results you can measure — let’s connect.
